boundSources.faceReading: CC-1473 prints VA. CODE § 19.2-392.2(A) — ACQUITTAL/DISMISSAL — as its sole authority, and its Part 1 basis is one a § 19.2-392.2(B) petitioner cannot truthfully swear. The family's own legal-design record (data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/VA.memo.json) states 'CC-1473 is captioned to subsection (A) alone and is not it' and resolves the strategy to custom_pleading. CC-1473 is therefore bound as the REFERENCE instrument for the shared § 19.2-392.2 petition procedure and is never included in the rendered packet. The DETERMINATION_CC1203_SUBSTITUTION record was read first: it governs the two sealing families (CC-1201/CC-1203, § 19.2-392.12 / § 19.2-392.12:1) and does not name this expungement family; no substitution question arises and no form was substituted.
